uifix.distribution: source; not published as a public npm package

playwright.source: pinned UIFix dependency lockfile unless VISUAL_QA_PLAYWRIGHT_FROM selects the app's installed Playwright
playwright.browser: matching Playwright Chromium; CHROME_PATH is an optional executable override

launchPolicy.fallback: fail closed; never retry with Chromium sandbox disabled
launchPolicy.executableOverride: CHROME_PATH may select only an operator-approved compatible Chromium binary; it does not prove sandbox enforcement

playwright.runtimeRequirement: Use an authorized runtime that supports Chromium sandboxing and the repository's isolated TestRunner policy; this config requests sandboxing but cannot attest the kernel/runtime actually enforced it. No root-container or host-network fallback is supported.
